hypothesis: An incremental ANSI producer can feed less before EOF while preserving interactive controls.
mechanism: Native stdin-enabled LESSOPEN input pipe (|-), no shell spool
limitations: Line-local JSON and fixed 100-column width only; does not prove multiline lexer state, Markdown streaming, full-file throughput, production width semantics, or polished cancellation. The prototype can emit KeyboardInterrupt/BrokenPipe diagnostics on interruption/early quit.
